headlines.title_en: Hong Kong securities industry profit up 21% in H1, total trading turnover hits record high
headlines.summary_en: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong released its latest Securities Industry Financial Review report, noting that Hong Kong's securities industry recorded steady growth in the first half of this year, with net profit increasing 21% from the second half of 2025 to HK$51.7 billion. Securities brokers saw strong growth in trading activity and rising client participation, driving a substantial increase in profit compared with the second half of 2025. In the first half of this year, total trading turnover of securities brokers jumped 24% from the second half of 2025 to a record HK$149 trillion; the number of active clients as of June also rose 10% to about 5.7 million. Among brokers' main revenue sources, trading commissions and interest income increased 13% from the second half of 2025 to HK$45.4 billion, partly offsetting a 21% decline in asset management-related fee income to HK$24.4 billion, so total industry revenue remained roughly flat. headlines.title_en: French far-right leader Le Pen unveils ambitious fiscal plan, targeting French deficit below 3% by 2032
headlines.summary_en: French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen, leader of the far-right National Rally party, proposed an ambitious new fiscal plan aimed at reducing France's fiscal deficit to below 3% of gross domestic product (GDP) by 2032, with a plan to bring the French deficit below 5% starting in 2027. Le Pen unveiled the National Rally's budget proposal for next year on Tuesday, which would be implemented if she wins the upcoming French presidential election. She is seeking to reassure investors as concerns about France's political outlook and ballooning debt trigger bond market turmoil.

headlines.title: 官方回应原中国电信员工实名举报多名高管
headlines.summary: 近日，自称中国电信原员工的郑季衍在网上实名举报，受到广泛关注。10月6日下午，中国电信股份有限公司大客户事业部在官方公众号“中国电信政企服务”发布贴图称，近期关注到郑季衍相关信息，“郑季衍原为我部门员工，自2023年起无理由旷工635天，期间多次劝说无效”。依据有关规定，于2026年8月31日依法解除与郑季衍的劳动关系。至于郑季衍所提及的工业互联网大数据中心项目，中国电信股份有限公司大客户事业部表示，已于2024年进行过内部专项核查，其言论与事实不符。（界面）

headlines.title_en: Official response to former China Telecom employee's real-name report against multiple executives
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Zheng Jiyan, who claims to be a former employee of China Telecom, made a real-name report online, drawing widespread attention. On the afternoon of October 6, the Key Account Business Unit of China Telecom Corporation Limited posted on its official WeChat account "China Telecom Government and Enterprise Services," saying it had recently noted information related to Zheng Jiyan, and that "Zheng Jiyan was formerly an employee of our department and had been absent from work without reason for 635 days since 2023, despite repeated attempts at persuasion during that period proving ineffective." In accordance with relevant regulations, the labor relationship with Zheng Jiyan was lawfully terminated on August 31, 2026. As for the Industrial Internet Big Data Center project mentioned by Zheng Jiyan, the Key Account Business Unit of China Telecom Corporation Limited said it had conducted an internal special review in 2024 and that his statements were inconsistent with the facts. (Jiemian)

headlines.title_en: KPMG: Hong Kong IPO fundraising exceeds HK$388 billion in first three quarters, full-year expected to break HK$500 billion and hit record high
headlines.summary_en: KPMG released its "Mainland China and Hong Kong IPO Markets Q3 2026 Review," showing that there are currently more than 600 active listing applications, and Hong Kong is expected to record its strongest annual fundraising performance ever, with full-year fundraising potentially reaching HK$500 billion. KPMG said Hong Kong's initial public offering (IPO) market set a record high for fundraising in the first nine months of any year, with 116 new listings raising more than HK$388 billion, more than double the same period last year. With market momentum remaining strong, Hong Kong is expected to break the annual fundraising record of HK$427 billion set in 2010 and set its highest annual fundraising amount ever. A+H listings continued to be the main growth engine of Hong Kong's IPO market. headlines.title: 华为徐直军：昇腾中国市场份额已超英伟达，中国芯片自主化是必然之路
headlines.summary: 日前，在上海举行的华为全联接（HC）大会期间，华为发布了面向AI时代的Peerium计算架构，以及作为其关键互联技术的UnifiedBus灵衢总线。 发布会后，华为轮值董事长徐直军与海思首席科学家廖恒，就华为新发布的AI时代的Peerium计算架构和灵衢总线（UnifiedBus），与媒体进行了交流。

headlines.title_en: Huawei's Xu Zhijun: Ascend's China market share already exceeds Nvidia's, China's chip self-reliance is an inevitable path
headlines.summary_en: Recently, during Huawei Connect (HC) held in Shanghai, Huawei released the Peerium computing architecture for the AI era, as well as the UnifiedBus Lingqu bus as its key interconnect technology. After the launch event, Huawei Rotating Chairman Xu Zhijun and HiSilicon Chief Scientist Liao Heng exchanged views with the media on Huawei's newly released Peerium computing architecture for the AI era and the UnifiedBus Lingqu bus.

headlines.title: 国庆假期后首个交易日20只基金将集中开启认购
headlines.summary: 10月8日是假期后首个交易日，有20只基金将开启认购，形成10月首个发行小高峰。20只产品中包含被动指数型基金7只、偏股混合型基金5只、债券型基金3只、增强指数型基金3只，另有FOF基金和REITs各1只。从投资主题看，科技成长方向布局最为集中，涉及科创板芯片设计、科创创业人工智能、软件开发、机器人等多个细分领域。红利与价值风格同步升温，银华中证全指红利质量ETF、广发中证红利低波动ETF、农银国证价值100等指数产品相继上新。值得注意的是，刚刚过去的三季度，新基金发行呈现“数量增、份额减”的结构性特征。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: 20 funds to launch subscription simultaneously on first trading day after National Day holiday
headlines.summary_en: October 8 is the first trading day after the holiday, and 20 funds will open for subscription, forming the first small issuance peak in October. The 20 products include 7 passive index funds, 5 partial-equity hybrid funds, 3 bond funds, 3 enhanced index funds, and 1 each of FOF funds and REITs. In terms of investment themes, the technology growth direction is the most concentrated, involving multiple sub-sectors such as STAR Market chip design, STAR and ChiNext artificial intelligence, software development, and robotics. Dividend and value styles are also heating up simultaneously, with index products such as Yinhua CSI All Share Dividend Quality ETF, GF CSI Dividend Low Volatility ETF, and ABC Guozheng Value 100 launching one after another. It is worth noting that in the just-passed third quarter, new fund issuance showed a structural characteristic of "more in number, less in shares." (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title_en: Hang Seng Index closes up 1%, Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.94%
headlines.summary_en: Pharmaceutical stocks led the gains, with CanSino Biologics up about 14% and Sino Biopharmaceutical up about 4%. Property stocks rose, with Shimao Group up about 13% and R&F Properties up about 9%. Technology stocks and large-model stocks rose, with Zhipu up about 8% and MINIMAX up about 2%; Baidu Group up about 3% and Alibaba up about 3%.
